name: Captain Vimes
summary: Lieutenant Aden sends you with the orc report you found to Captain Garran Vimes, who reads orcish better than most. News of Horde spies near Theramore is to go with it.

sections.title: A Report for the Captain
sections.body: Lieutenant Aden thinks the orc report you found belongs in the hands of Captain Garran Vimes, who reads orcish better than most. Aden also wants the captain told that Horde spies are lurking close to Theramore. You will find Vimes at the barracks on Theramore Isle's northeastern side.

faq.q: Who sends you to Captain Vimes?
aliases: where do i get captain vimes
faq.answer: Lieutenant Aden, who wants the captain to see the orc report you found.

faq.q: Where is Captain Garran Vimes located?
faq.answer: At the barracks, on Theramore Isle's northeastern side.

faq.q: Why does Captain Vimes need to see the report?
aliases: why does vimes need the report
faq.answer: Aden says Vimes reads orcish better than most, and should hear that Horde spies are close to Theramore.
